translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content.text: Gct, batrpz nzaxvctr-krbz king rgr mz zmrlz ngrm,
X okatrpz nide mz nzvz-nqblq-krde nztubq-krm.
Murde nzaclve-krde nigr leplz nemqng namrlz,
X na-atubqtibzle da mz kxnzobqszong.
X nigr amrlx sa namnc-zpwxkr,
Mz nzmnclz-krbzkr mz nztubqkr nzaclvekr king rgr.
Sa natubz mz nibr kxnzobqszong,
X sa na-arlapxle kx trpnzngr scdr zmatq mz nzaovxio-krde kxnzakxputilr nidr.
Nzamrluekr leplz nim sa navz zvz,
Da kc tqwai nzyzlr-zvzkr nepi x temz.
X King nem sa na-amrlzle nigr leplz nedeng,
Mz nzapu-krde tewa kc tqdcom mz nrlanc.
Mzli kc tqngini-ngrde king nztubqngr naetunepx mz nrlc,
X nzmnc-zpwxkr leplz navz zvz da kc tqwai nzyzlr-zvzkr temz.
Nzaclve-krde yzutrle mz Lue Yufretis,
Nakrlzbzle mz nrlc tulvzo.
Enqmi rdeng sa na-aovxioleng,
X nayrngzobzng bade.
King mz nrlc tulvzo sa nartwzmqng bade dalr nzrle-kangr,
Myapxbz king r trmctung, x Arabia, x Afrika, murde namnc-lxblrng badr mz nrwx.
King amrlx sa nayrngzobzng bade,
X leplz amrlx sa na-angiolr nide.
King lc sa natubz mz nibr kx trpnzngr scdr da, mz nzkqle-krdr nide.
X naokatrle kxnzobqszong kcng tzmncng esz'-krdr.
Sa naycngr drtwrde kxtrnzxplrung x kx trpnzngr scdr zmatq.
X na-arlapxle nra-nzlung ngr leplz.
Sa naxpepxle nidr mz mq kxnzakxputing x kxnzatrkatilr nidr,
Murde matq mz drtwrde nzlu-krdr.

content: Da Kxmrlzting Kx Navzpxmqng Mz Nzaclve-krde

content.text: Leplz amrlx sa nakrka'-ngrdr nide
Murde Gct na-amrlz-zvzle nide,
Mz nzrpi-krdr kx, “Gct, king lc nalu angidr zvz.
X lr Arabia narkabzng gol kxpnapr bade.”
Krka'-ngrgr kx nrlanc nyzgrng nalvc-angidrngr dakxnzng.
X nounc nyzgrng nadobeting na-apule nounc ngr drtc' kc Lebanon.
X taon nyzgrng nayrbu mz leplz
Na-apule nzyrukr nabr ngr nardzng.
King lc nadcpx zvz mz drtwr.
X drtqde nayc zvz mz nzapu-krde nzti-zvzkr nepi.
Murde sa nanginide nou nzamrlzkr Gct leplz amrlx mz nrlc,
Mz nzkrlz-krdr kx matq-esz'ngr mz nzobqkr Gct.
Naglqlzku Yawe, Gct r melrmqgung.
Nide txpwz kxnzkctipx. Naglqlzku Yawe.
Navz navz zvz nzangiongr drtqde.
Nzrglqlzngr nide navz navz zvz.
Krlc me yrkrpxngr nabz x nzkrka'-ngrng kx yr King Devet, mrlx Jesi.

footnotes.text: Jiszs sa na-angidati-zpwxle drtwr ngr Sam lc mz nzvz-krmle krali.
